defs.def: at or to a greater distance * far 的比较级

ex.s: If you’re willing to drive a little further, the Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles promises luxurious rooms and extensive leisure facilities — perfect for turning a game day into a great weekend escape.
ex.t: 如果你愿意再开远一点，洛杉矶丽思卡尔顿酒店承诺提供豪华客房和丰富的休闲设施——非常适合把比赛日变成一次美妙的周末度假。

ex.s: But when we persist with the wrong thing, every bit of effort takes us further from where we are meant to be.
ex.t: 但当我们坚持错误的方向时，每一点努力都会让我们离本该到达的地方更远。

ex.s: ►Failing at the right thing takes us further from where we are meant to be.
ex.t: ►在正确的事情上失败也会让我们离本该到达的地方更远。

ex.s: Mr Dena kept an unforgettable ___41___ by Sir Isaac Newton on his chalk board: “If I have been able to see further, it is only because I stand on the shoulders of giants.” He reflected on that throughout the year and was ___42___ to teach us more than math.
ex.t: 德纳先生在黑板上保留了一句艾萨克·牛顿爵士的难忘___41___

ex.s: The key finding of the study was that when crowds were further divided into smaller groups that were allowed to have a discussion, the averages from these groups were more accurate than those from an equal number of independent individuals.
ex.t: 该研究的关键发现是：当人群被进一步分成可以进行讨论的小组时，这些小组的平均值比同等数量的独立个体的平均值更准确。

ex.s: A further explanation of the research methods.
ex.t: 对研究方法的进一步解释。

ex.s: Conducting further research.
ex.t: 进行进一步的研究。

ex.s: If you’re looking for cleanliness and a modern hostel, look no further than Youth Station.
ex.t: 如果你在寻找干净整洁和现代化的旅舍，Youth Station就是你的不二选择。

ex.s: Always keep a pencil and paper beside you. ____20____Note also the facts important for your purpose as well as anything which leads you to further research.

ex.s: The best books are the ones that open further as time passes.
ex.t: 最好的书是那些随着时间推移愈发深邂的书。

ex.s: The engineers at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology（MIT）have taken it a step further changing the actual composition of plants in order to get them to perform diverse，even unusual functions.

ex.s: Further up, the weather   55   — low clouds envelope the mountainsides, which are covered with thick grass.
ex.t: 再往上，天气变了——低云笼罩着山坡，山上覆盖着茂密的草。

ex.s: D．To further explore historical mysteries．
ex.t: D．进一步探索历史之谎．

ex.s: In a further twist, birth rate is highest in poorly educated rural areas and lowest in highly educated urban areas.
ex.t: 更进一步的是，出生率在教育程度低的农村地区最高，在教育程度高的城市地区最低。

defs.def: a longer way in the past or the future （过去或未来）较远，更久远

ex.s: I was performing this action of waiting until it later became  43  .Once that happened, I just kept   44  my studying further and further back in my day.

defs.def: to a greater degree or extent 进一步；在更大程度上；在更大范围内
in addition to what has just been said 此外；而且

ex.s: The pressures of "time" and "destination" are further blocks to awareness． I encountered many hikers who were headed to a distant camp﹣ground with just enough time to get there before dark． It seldom occurred to them to wander a bit， to take a moment to see what's around them． I asked them what they'd seen． "Oh， a few birds， "they said． They seemed bent on their destinations．
ex.t: A．渴望创造奇迹

defs.def: to say more about sth, or make a more extreme point about it 进一步说；提出更极端的意见

ex.s: To further explain a point.
ex.t: 进一步解释一个观点。

ex.s: In the beginning，I dared myself to make a difference in the life of another person．Now that our project is over，I realize that I have affected not only one life，but ten．With our efforts，ten young boys and girls will now be able to further their education．
ex.t: 一开始我鼓起勇气想要改变另一个人的生活．现在我们的项目结束了我意识到我影响的不只是一个生命而是十个．通过我们的努力十个伊拉克儿童现在将能够继续接受教育．

defs.def: to last longer; to serve more people 更经久；为更多人服务

ex.s: Don't hesitate to ask Student B for further information about the town.
ex.t: 不要犹豫，向学生B询问关于这个城镇的更多信息。

ex.s: Give directions and be prepared to provide further information about your town.
ex.t: 给出方向，并准备好提供关于你城镇的更多信息。

ex.t: 如有必要，做进一步的研究。有用的表达……

ex.s: For example, advances in virtual reality and wearable tech, as well as the BTP BETWEEN THE PAGES flexible battery, mean we should soon be seeing further developments.
ex.t: 例如，虚拟现实和可穿戴技术以及柔性电池的进步，意味着我们很快应该会看到更多的发展。

ex.s: By early May, emergency aid worth 9.7 million US dollars had been donated by China, with a further round of emergency aid to follow.
ex.t: 到五月初，中国已捐赠了价值970万美元的紧急援助，还有新一轮的紧急援助将随后到来。
